{{Quote|Sithspawn can be grown from any stock, be it human or Yuvernian.|Sorzus Syn|<ref name="Book of Sith">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
'''Yuvernians''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of tall, two-headed beings, with each head sitting atop its own long thin neck. At least one Yuvernian had mottled [[Color/Legends|yellow]] skin covered with dark spots. The Yuvernian [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] was the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yuvern/Legends|Yuvern]], where parenting in the species' society was carried out by groups called [[parental collective]]s. [[Cane Adiss/Legends|Cane Adiss]] was a Yuvernian who left Yuvern and traveled across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], becoming a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] for the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]], despite the wishes of his parental collective that he focus on matters related to his homeworld.

==Biology and appearance==
The Yuvernians were a [[Snake/Legends|snakelike]]<ref name="cswe">{{CSWECite|I|11|Adiss, Cane}}</ref> [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="db" /> and at least one of their members had mottled yellow skin covered with dark spots. Yuvernians had two heads, and each head sat atop its own long thin neck.<ref name="ROTJ" /> The [[Color/Legends|color]] of the Yuvernian [[Cane Adiss/Legends|Cane Adiss's]] spots varied, with one head and neck possessing dark gray spots and the other having ones that were purple in appearance.<ref name="chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles]]''</ref> Each head had an elongated [[Bone/Legends|skull]], and while the rear of one cranium took the shape of a round elevated ridge, the rear of its opposite number gave form to a thinner, more cylindrical protrusion that had wispy black [[Hair/Legends|hair]] falling from it.<ref name="ROTJ" />

Both of Cane Adiss's heads had blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] that were found on the sides of his heads, as well as a beaklike snout. At least one of his heads possessed a mouthful of [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] that included both upper and lower fangs.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Yuvernians were considered large beings, with Adiss standing at 2.4 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and measuring 4.8 meters long. They could not comfortably fit into the majority of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighters]], and Adiss was required to use the private [[Turbolift/Legends|elevator]] of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] when in the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord's]] [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]], as no other lifts were large enough.<ref name="db" />

==Society and culture==
[[File:Cane_Adiss_puppet.jpg|thumb|left|140px|Cane Adiss was a Yuvernian who explored the greater galaxy.]]
Yuvernians hailed from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yuvern/Legends|Yuvern]],<ref name="db" /> in the [[Yuvern system/Legends|Yuvern system]]<ref name="ea">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> of the [[Oplovis sector/Legends|Oplovis sector]]. Parenting in their society was carried out by groups called [[parental collective]]s, who believed that young members of the species should concentrate on Yuvernian affairs rather than on the outside galaxy. Yuvernians were allowed to leave their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] when they came of age. Offworlders sometimes visited the planet, including [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] and representatives of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="db" />

==History==
Yuvernians were known to the galaxy by [[6900 BBY]], when the [[Jen'jidai]] [[Sorzus Syn]] wrote about [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] in a [[Sorzus Syn's chronicle|chronicle]] of the use of the [[dark side of the Force]]. She mentioned that [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] could be grown from any stock, including [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and Yuvernians.<ref name="Book of Sith" /> Yuvernians were allowed to leave their homeworld after coming of age,<ref name="db" /> and [[Unidentified Yuvernian|one such]] Yuvernian was spotted at [[Fornax Station]] prior to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="frr">''[[Adventures in Hyperspace: Fire Ring Race]]''</ref> Another was Cane Adiss, who constantly dreamed of exploring the galaxy in his youth. He left Yuvern before [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] with the [[Quor'sav/Legends|Quor'sav]] trader [[Kal'Falnl C'ndros]] and developed strong [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] skills, visiting dozens of worlds. After parting ways with C'ndros, Adiss began working as a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] for the crime lord Jabba the Hutt on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Before [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the Imperial [[Oplovis]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was in the Yuvern [[Star system/Legends|system]] and [[Battle in the Yuvern system|engaged]] a fleet belonging the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Adiss observed the battle from a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of his own as the Imperials were overwhelmed and fled the system.<ref name="db" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I left 'parental collective' in as a broader hint that their culture differed from Humans and similar species in important ways.|John Hazlett discusses his development of the Yuvernian species|<ref name="blog">{{Blog|jSarek|2|Behind the Scenes - Cane Adiss}}</ref>}}
Cane Adiss is the only named Yuvernian to appear in ''[[Star Wars]]'' media to date, having debuted in [[Richard Marquand]]'s [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] as an unnamed background puppet. He can be seen in at least one shot, when [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] is being led from Jabba's throne room by a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|guard]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> However, the book [[Star Wars Chronicles|''Star Wars: Chronicles'']] claims that Adiss did not make the final cut of the film,<ref name="ww">{{InsiderCite|60|Who's Who in Jabba's Palace}}</ref> and the CD-ROM ''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]'' asserts that the Adiss puppet was built for the film but is only seen in its "[[The Making of Star Wars: Return of the Jedi|making-of]]" reference book.<ref name="magic">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> The puppet was initially painted orange with dark orange spots, and it was the subject of a joke between [[Industrial Light & Magic]] employees: during a photoshoot of their creature shop, they hung a "NO HUNTING" sign on one of the puppet's necks.<ref name="chronicles" /> During production, the puppet was referred to as "Cane Heads."<ref name="Pablo">{{SW|url=news/return-of-the-jedi-creature-history-with-pablo-hidalgo|text=''Return of the Jedi'' Creature History with Pablo Hidalgo|nolive=1}}</ref>

[[File:Cane_Adiss_under_construction.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Construction of the Cane Adiss puppet]]
Adiss's species was not identified as Yuvernian until [[2006]], when his backstory was developed for [[StarWars.com]]'s [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]] feature "[[What's The Story?]]" by [[John Hazlett]] (writing as "jSarek"). Hazlett established Adiss as a Yuvernian from Yuvern, a planet that had been introduced in [[1990]]'s ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''.<ref name="blog" /> To this day, no photo or description exists of Yuvernians below their necks.

Hazlett originally gave additional details regarding the Yuvernian parental collective in his entry, including the fact that all adults of the species were required to look over a [[Galactic Standard Calendar|year's]] hatching of Yuvernian [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] in any given community. He also surmised that in the collective, the year of an egg's hatching was more important than the identity of the egg-layer. Realizing that he had to detail these facts unobtrusively in the context of Cane's life, Hazlett cut them early in the writing process.<ref name="blog" />
